System: The Water Beast is an ancient divine beast. Chiyou tamed it with his Firecry Ring, losing 21 generals doing it, then fed it the Soul of the Martial World and the Myriad-Year Water Essence. Its power soared; nothing under heaven could match it! But when the Flame Emperor attacked, the ring broke and the beast fled, whereabouts unknown. Since then it has soaked up the qi of heaven and earth and the land's holy soul-power, pushing itself to the limit. Now it's invincible. Even the Buddha can't do a thing about it...
